logline: Ronaldo turns two farewell posts into a like race: his comment on Messi's goodbye gets 5M, his own goodbye passes Messi's 20M in 8 hours — until Messi quietly scrolls back to his World Cup post, the most-liked post ever.

beats.idea: Messi's farewell post on a giant phone, counter to 20M
Ronaldo comments 'All my respect' — the comment gets 5M likes, he counts them
Ronaldo's farewell post: the like bar rockets past Messi's 20M line in 8 hours
Ronaldo's eyes with the counter reflected: 41M
over Messi's shoulder: he starts a comment on Ronaldo's post, sees 41M vs his 20M, deletes it (imaginary; real: he never commented)
saving face: Messi calmly scrolls to his World Cup post, 70M+, the bar smashes the ceiling
Ronaldo frantically likes his own post +1 +1, Messi sips mate

twist: Messi's World Cup post is the most-liked post ever
callback: Messi's mate (running gag) and Ronaldo counting everything
hidden_details: Ronaldo's phone case has his own face
the 8-hour clock is shaped like a 7
Messi's World Cup post shows the trophy
meme_frame: Messi's bar smashing through the ceiling while Ronaldo stares
